_comment: Per-tile SMRF parameter overrides for scripts/batch_process.py. Keys are LAZ filenames as they appear in data/raw/. Any tile not listed here falls back to _default and gets a loud warning logged -- these parameters are terrain-dependent judgment calls (see CLAUDE.md item #10), not something safe to guess blindly for a new tile. Keys starting with '_' are metadata/comments and are stripped before use.

USGS_LPC_Eastern_Pima_County_Lidar_98039._comment: Flat desert, sparse vegetation (NumberOfReturns avg 1.023). These ARE the _default values -- kept explicit here so the mapping is visible without cross-referencing _default.

tucson_mtns_484572_epsg6405.laz._comment: Steep terrain (328 ft relief over ~251 acres) with real canopy (35.16% multi-return points, mean NumberOfReturns 1.4137 -- cacti and trees, not sparse desert scrub). Derived this session by measuring terrain slope directly (gdaldem slope -p on a vendor-ground probe DEM: median 28%, p90 91.5%) and then iterating through 5 parameter sets while visually inspecting hillshades -- NOT copied from defaults and NOT guessed. Full derivation story, including two dead-end iterations and the reasoning for the last-return prefilter, is in CLAUDE.md under item #10.
